title: Parish and Alibi
author: Petra Joubert
blurb: Mirabel Eastwick, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
